ITEM 1 | Mound of small round tan-brown grains or pellets, roughly spherical, about 0.4 cm each, matte surface with slight sheen, clustered in an irregular heap covering about 15% of the plate's upper-left area, roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm high, with a few scattered loose grains at its edge | 110
ITEM 2 | Small pieces of dark green vegetable, thin strips and flat slivers about 0.5 to 1.5 cm long, some bright green and some darker, mixed among and beneath the grain mound at its lower-left edge, with a few pale yellow-green bits | 8
ITEM 3 | Small pale beige-yellow cubes or flakes about 0.5 cm, matte, sitting on top of and among the grain mound near its upper-middle, possibly a soft starchy piece | 5
